name: manual_047126
claim: A production, CI, or installer consumer must explicitly declare either a fixed generation or an edge; only an edge resolves the reviewed ACTIVE pointer, and undeclared consumers refuse. Option A checks the selected generation against repeated existing pins and does not change a running environment. A running-system rollback separately switches between operator-provisioned generation-specific environments after the G4/G5 drill; Option B remains optional G2b constraints indirection for fresh installs.

decisions.notes: Supersedes the accepted claim to separate explicit selector semantics, Option A pin-consistency validation, the operator-provisioned G4/G5 environment switch for running rollback, and optional G2b fresh-install constraints indirection.

rationale: Supersedes the accepted claim to separate explicit selector semantics, Option A pin-consistency validation, the operator-provisioned G4/G5 environment switch for running rollback, and optional G2b fresh-install constraints indirection.
